dedupe_keys.name: open bodem index soil condition calculator

description: The Open Bodem Index Calculator is an R package that scores agricultural soil condition. The NMI README says its index covers chemical, physical, biological and management criteria through more than 21 indicators, and links CRAN releases and function documentation. Users supply soil measurements and field-management information; outputs are indicator and aggregate scores for the assessed field. Geographic coverage follows fields for which required inputs and interpretation rules apply, with a Dutch programme context. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing. A limitation is that a composite score is not a direct forecast of crop yield, infiltration or soil failure; indicator weights and sampling depth need review for other regions. The calculator can provide soil-condition context for crop-water and agricultural land simulations. The related QGIS catalogue platform can map fields but does not calculate this index. No soil measurements or R package were downloaded.
inputs: Soil chemistry, physical, biological and management indicators
